messages.content: Let me check coverage for that area.

function.name: check_service_zone
function.description: Checks whether a US zip code is in our service area. Returns {covered, accepting_new_jobs, market, zone, state, notes}. Always call this BEFORE start_new_intake — if the zip is not covered, say so honestly and offer to escalate to the office to double-check for exceptions.

zip_code.description: 5-digit US zip code (the appliance location's zip).
